opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st day of February, April, June, August, October and December (bi-monthly)

amount.raw: Scheme (A) up to £200; Scheme (B) up to £500 (up to £750 for Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored awards); Scheme (C) up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society 'junior scientist' members: Scheme (A) open to undergraduate, Master's and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva; Schemes (B) & (C) open to PhD student and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Applicants must present a poster or give a talk at the conference.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences on research in Genetics, across three streams: (A) Genetics Society/SIG meetings, (B) non-Genetics Society meetings, and (C) virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant

deadlines.raw: quarterly, at midnight on 15th February, May, August and November

opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society, as long as studying or working in the UK, or the course is held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be a member for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Enables members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member can apply, regardless of age of the person they are caring for. Priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Provides an award to support members with caring responsibilities to attend Genetics Society meetings and events.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: From a few hundred pounds for a specific lecture to up to about £1,000 for a session; major sponsorship of an entire meeting potentially several thousand pounds (recent major sponsorship levels £1,000-£2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members; meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, towards the organisation of a meeting (not attendance).

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st March and 1st October (two deadlines per year)

opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members; meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings.
